name: How long does it take for hard water stains to reappear after cleaning?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for hard water stains to reappear after cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes for hard water stains to reappear depends on several factors: the hardness of your water, how frequently the fixture is used, and how thoroughly it's dried after each use. In areas with very hard water and high usage, stains can start to show again within days or a week. With softer water and diligent drying, they might not reappear for several weeks or even months.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stain recurrence depends on water hardness, fixture usage, and drying habits; it can range from days in very hard water areas to weeks or months with softer water and diligent drying.
